Name: Land Grants - Unlimited Players and Farms in Multiplayer
Author: Platonymous
Description:
[center][heading]Land Grants[/heading] by Platonymous
[line]
Everyone gets their own a farm in Multiplayer.

[size=1](BETA - Still buggy! Still in Development.)
[/size][img]https://imgur.com/T5Eybda.png[/img]
Host a multiplayer game with more than 3 Starting Cabins (4+).
You can't build new farms (yet), so choose how many extra farms you think you need (but at least 4).
(Less than 4 cabins will result in the game playing normally, though the unlimited player part should is still be in effect.)

Farms are stacked on top of each other, only the busstop entry/exit is the same for everyone.
Unless changed in the config: Farms of Farmers that aren't online can't be entered and don't progress.

Every Player needs to have this mod.
Saves created with this mod, won't run without it.
The more farms you have the more it will impact your load times.

Still in beta, still buggy. Please post every bug or oddity you encounter in Posts.

[b]Things that should already work fine:[/b]
Having your own farm
Farming
Moving between farms
Upgrading your FarmHouse
Buildings
Animals (but not pets)
